falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: A decisive upside break invalidates the mini_top_2019_jun analogue and shows HOLD/UNKNOWN was wrong: the phase resolved to trend continuation, not an unresolved top.

falsification_conditions.condition: S&P 500 cash index closes at least 5% below its highest daily close of the prior 20 sessions and the VIX closes above 25 on the same day, within 14 calendar days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: A confirmed air-pocket decline would prove the mini-top active and show HOLD was the wrong signal; the correct call would have been risk-off, not unknown/hold.

falsification_conditions.condition: ICE BofA US High Yield OAS tightens by 40 basis points or more from the latest close and the blowoff score prints below 40, both within 14 calendar days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: Credit confirmation of risk appetite plus a collapsed blowoff score falsifies both the mini-top similarity and the unresolved HOLD stance, implying a pause inside a risk-on regime rather than an unknown top.

doctrine: If you can't list what would prove your call wrong, you don't have a real call.
